summary: Product-image review: create and update share the same optional-field validator, require the exact business/product path, and preserve existing catalog authorization. Unknown fields, cross-business paths and cross-product paths are denied. Server functions authorize saved cerms business access and catalog permissions, bound file bytes/pixels, decode and normalize supported raster formats, and create immutable files only within the cerms5/catalog prefix. Image reads verify the current product attachment. Shared Storage rules and legacy paths are unchanged. Synthetic server, desktop and rules checks passed; this review is not deployment evidence.

deploymentIsolationReview.finding: Legacy Storage rules allow public reads and writes. Preserve these rules for legacy compatibility; do not use the bucket for new protected images.
deploymentIsolationReview.legacyStorageExtension: Existing finalization extension is attached only to the old bucket; new uploads do not trigger it.
